description:
Return a brand-themed @theme inline CSS block for shadcn/ui + Tailwind v4.
Defaults to the 0n brand theme (dark, accent #6EE05A green-teal-purple gradient).
Drop into globals.css directly after @import "tailwindcss".

brand.description: Brand preset — '0n' for the dark green-teal-purple system, 'default' for shadcn defaults
